clauses.reason: Terminated by Executive Order 12553, signed February 25, 1986, which orders that the listed Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked, with no stated delayed effective date and no saving clause; the effective date is therefore the signing date, 1986-02-25. The table of revoked orders in the held text of Executive Order 12553 lists number 10015 with the subject "Amending an order creating an emergency board to investigate railroad labor disputes". This clause is the lead-in under which the order amends Executive Order 10010, which Executive Order 12553 revokes in the same table, so the amendment has nothing left to operate on.
